newsitem.title: USA: Hearing set on CSX /Conrail merger.
newsitem.headline: Hearing set on CSX /Conrail merger.

text.p: The House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee will hold a hearing Nov. 19 on the proposed CSX -Conrail merger, Chairman Bud Shuster, R-Pennsylvania said Friday.

"The committee will look at several questions including: what does the merger mean for rail service and employment nationally? What does the merger mean for rail services and emploment in states and localities?" Shuster said in a statement.
"We must be certain that on balance this merger will enhance competition, improve transportation services and protect the rights of employees," Shuster said.

He said witnesses would include management of the two railroads, administration officials and representatives from labor unions, shippers, other railroads, other modes of transportation and consumer groups.
He said the merger may raise unique questions that Congress might have to deal with because Conrail was created by the federal government after the Penn Central bankruptcy.
